name: Sheila Pryce Brooks
abstract_title: Threshold Contact Experience (TCE): Reframing Sleep Paralysis through a Consciousness-Based Lens
abstract: Sleep paralysis has traditionally been interpreted as a sleep-related dissociative state or neurophysiological anomaly, attributed to REM intrusion and hypnagogic hallucination. Yet across cultures and historical periods, experiencers describe episodes with consistent perceptual, relational, and symbolic features that extend beyond conventional sleep-disorder frameworks.
